name: Reflect Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but no rewards program; the entire point is a long 0% intro APR

verdict.text: Keep only for the long 0% intro period; skip it otherwise

earn_note: No cash back or points program of any kind. This card exists for one reason: one of the longest 0% intro APR periods available, for people who want to finance a purchase or pay down a balance transfer interest-free.

points.note: There is nothing to redeem. Choose this card for the intro APR, not for ongoing value.

transfer_partners.highlight: No rewards currency exists on this card, so there is nothing to transfer.

insurance.detail: Up to $600 per claim against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: Cell phone protection is the one real benefit here, and it matches the Active Cash Card's terms. Nothing else is advertised: no purchase protection, extended warranty, rental car coverage, or trip insurance.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage is publicly documented for this card.

services.name: 0% intro APR, 21 months
services.detail: 0% for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (transfers must be made within 120 days of account opening), then a variable 17.49%, 23.99%, or 28.24% APR. One of the longest intro periods available on any card.

services.name: Foreign transaction fee
services.detail: 3% of each transaction, converted to US dollars.

services.name: My Wells Fargo Deals
services.detail: Personalized merchant offers that earn a statement credit when you shop through the app.

services.name: Roadside Dispatch
services.detail: 24/7 towing and roadside assistance, billed to the card at time of dispatch, no membership fee.

services.name: Credit Close-Up
services.detail: Free monthly FICO score updates and credit report insights through the Wells Fargo app.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users
additional_cards.note: No distinct authorized-user program is marketed for this card.

timeline.text: Wells Fargo launches Reflect as a no-annual-fee card built around a long 0% intro APR, positioned for people who want breathing room on a purchase or balance transfer rather than rewards.
